WEEKEND ACADEMY COMMUNICATION APP (WACA)

Client: Weekend Academy
Purpose: Centralized digital platform for student communication, admin notifications, and online service requests.

🔹 1. App Overview

WACA will enable students to sign up, log in, chat with administrators, receive announcements, notifications, and access online services.
The system includes both a mobile app (for students) and an admin dashboard (for staff).

🔹 2. Core Modules
Module	Description
Authentication	Secure signup/login using email, phone, or student ID.
Notification System	Admin can broadcast push notifications or messages to specific groups or all users.
Chat System	One-to-one chat between student and admin; optional group chat (class level).
Online Services	Request forms for certificates, training, or support.
Profile & Settings	Manage personal details and preferences.
Admin Dashboard	Web dashboard to manage users, messages, and announcements.
🔹 3. UI / UX Layout (Visual Flow)

🖥 Splash Screen:
Displays the Academy logo + tagline → auto-redirects to login.

🔐 Login Page:
Fields: Phone/Email + Password
Buttons: Login, Sign Up, Forgot Password

📝 Sign Up Page:
Fields: Full Name, Phone, Email, Password, Confirm Password, Course/Class
→ On submit, creates Firebase Auth record + profile in database.

🏠 Home Page (Main Tab):

Top bar: “Weekend Academy”

Sections:

Latest Announcements (auto-updated feed)

Quick links: Chat with Admin, Online Services, My Profile

💬 Chat Page:

Chat list with admins/support.

Real-time messaging (Firebase Firestore).

Notifications for new messages.

📢 Notifications Page:

Push + In-App Notifications.

Categories: General | Class | Event | Admin.

🛠 Online Services Page:

Request certificate, submit feedback, or ask questions.

Track service request status.

👤 Profile Page:

Display Name, Course, Student ID, Photo.

Edit button + logout.

params.query:
-- Create function to broadcast announcements changes
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION broadcast_announcements_changes()
RETURNS TRIGGER 
SECURITY DEFINER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  PERFORM realtime.broadcast_changes(
    'announcements',
    TG_OP,
    TG_OP,
    TG_TABLE_NAME,
    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
    NEW,
    OLD
  );
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$$;

-- Create function to broadcast messages changes
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION broadcast_messages_changes()
RETURNS TRIGGER 
SECURITY DEFINER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  PERFORM realtime.broadcast_changes(
    'messages:' || COALESCE(NEW.service_request_id, OLD.service_request_id)::text,
    TG_OP,
    TG_OP,
    TG_TABLE_NAME,
    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
    NEW,
    OLD
  );
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$$;

-- Create function to broadcast service requests changes
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION broadcast_service_requests_changes()
RETURNS TRIGGER 
SECURITY DEFINER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  PERFORM realtime.broadcast_changes(
    'service_requests:' || COALESCE(NEW.id, OLD.id)::text,
    TG_OP,
    TG_OP,
    TG_TABLE_NAME,
    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
    NEW,
    OLD
  );
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$$;

-- Create triggers
CREATE TRIGGER announcements_broadcast_trigger
  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON announcements
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION broadcast_announcements_changes();

CREATE TRIGGER messages_broadcast_trigger
  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON messages
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION broadcast_messages_changes();

CREATE TRIGGER service_requests_broadcast_trigger
  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON service_requests
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION broadcast_service_requests_changes();

-- Create a function to handle new user registration
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION handle_new_user()
RETURNS TRIGGER 
SECURITY DEFINER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, full_name, email, role)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', 'User'),
    NEW.email,
    CASE 
      WHEN NEW.email = 'admin@weekendacademy.com' THEN 'admin'
      ELSE 'student'
    END
  );
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- Create trigger for new user registration
CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_user();
